Step 1–7: Admin Panel Setup

Login as panacea@yopmail.com / guru@1234

1
Login Page — Role-Based Entry
This is the main entry point for all user roles. Enter your email and password — the system automatically redirects you to the correct portal (Admin, Customer, QSA, QA, or Consultant) based on your account type.

Start by logging in as the Super Administrator.
📧 Email: panacea@yopmail.com
🔑 Password: guru@1234
✅ Click "Sign In to Portal →"

2
Super Administrator Dashboard
The master control center. Shows live statistics: 43 Active Customers, 13 QSA Assessors, 20 QA Reviewers, 21 Consultants, 59 Active Compliance Projects, and 64 Audited Processes.

The left sidebar provides navigation to all admin sections. Click any stat card’s “Manage records →” to jump directly to that page.
👥 43 Active Customers
🔍 13 QSA Assessors
✅ 20 QA Reviewers
📋 59 Compliance Projects

3
Security Assessors & Auditors Management
Manage all QSA Assessors, QA Auditors, and Compliance Consultants. Use the filter tabs (All Assessors | QSA Assessors | QA Auditors | Consultants) to view by role.

• Click + Add New Assessor to register a new team member
• Click the 👁 eye icon on any row to reveal that user’s login password (enter admin password guru@1234 to confirm)

🔒 http://localhost:5173/admin/customers
4
Customer Organizations Management
All enterprise client organizations managed here. Each row shows Organization Name, POC Contact, Company Number, Email Address, and Status.

• Click + Add New Customer to onboard a new enterprise client (creates their portal login automatically)
• The ⧉ layers icon opens the customer’s audit scope/process management
• The 👁 eye icon reveals the customer POC’s login credentials
➕ “Add New Customer” to onboard an enterprise client
⧉ Layers icon → manage customer audit scopes
👁 Eye icon → view customer login credentials
🔒 http://localhost:5173/admin/compliances
5
5-Party Compliance Engagements
Where compliance projects are created — mapping a Framework Standard (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA) to a specific Customer & Scope, and assigning the QSA, QA, and Consultant.

Each row shows all 5 parties, milestone dates, and an “Audit View” button. Click “Assign New Project” to create a new 5-party engagement.
🏷 PCI DSS / ISO 27001 / HIPAA framework badges
👥 5-party: Customer + QSA + QA + Consultant + Admin
👁 “Audit View” → opens full compliance workspace
➕ “Assign New Project” → create new engagement
🔒 http://localhost:5173/admin/compliances/[project-id]
6
Project Audit & Review Workspace
The full compliance audit workspace. Top bar shows: Framework badge (PCI DSS), Customer, Scope, and live Status (e.g. “In Progress — 0/143 Approved”).

Left panel: 143 compliance control questions with 7 filter tabs:
• All Controls | Pending Submission | QSA Approved | QA Approved | Modification Requested | In Progress | Disapproved / Incomplete

Right panel (AOC & ROC tab): Upload Attestation of Compliance (AOC) PDF and Report on Compliance (ROC) PDF when audit completes.

The “Export Evidence Package” button exports a complete ZIP archive with all evidence, QSA papers, and SHA-256 manifest.
📋 143 compliance controls with 7 filter tabs
📄 Right panel: Upload AOC PDF and ROC PDF
📤 “Export Evidence Package” → full ZIP archive
📅 Milestone tab → set project completion dates
🔒 http://localhost:5173/admin/questionnaires
7
Questionnaire Controls & Checklist
Manage all audit requirement control questions. Select a Compliance Framework from the dropdown (PCI DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA) to see its full checklist.

Each question shows its Status (Active/Inactive). Use checkboxes to bulk activate or deactivate selected controls. Click the ✎ edit icon to modify question text. Click + Add New Question to create custom requirements for specific customer needs.
🖍 Framework dropdown: PCI DSS / ISO 27001 / HIPAA
✅ Bulk activate/deactivate selected questions
✎ Edit icon to modify control question text
➕ Add custom audit requirements
👤 Customer / POC Role

Step 8–9: Customer Evidence Submission

Log out → log in as Customer POC. Get credentials: Admin → Customers → 👁 Eye icon

🔒 http://localhost:5173/customer/dashboard
8
Customer Audit Workspace
After logging in as the Customer POC (e.g. John POC Officer), they see their Customer Audit Workspace listing all assigned compliance audit processes.

Each card shows the scope name (e.g. “Cardholder Data Environment (CDE-Production)”). Click “View Assigned Frameworks →” to see all frameworks, then click a framework to enter the Evidence Tracker.
📋 Shows all assigned audit scopes
→ Click “View Assigned Frameworks” to proceed
🔒 http://localhost:5173/customer/evidence/audit-view
9
⭐ Compliance Requirements & Evidence Tracker
The core Evidence Tracker — the most important view for the Customer POC. Lists all 143 compliance control requirements that need evidence documents submitted.

The 7 Filter Tabs let you instantly filter controls by audit status:
• All Controls — all 143 requirements
• Pending Submission — no evidence uploaded yet
• QSA Approved — approved by the QSA assessor
• QA Approved — final approval by QA auditor
• Modification Requested — assessor asked for changes
• In Progress — partially submitted
• Disapproved / Incomplete — rejected controls

Expand any control to: Upload Evidence Artifacts (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PNG, JPG), add a Submission Note, and click “Submit Evidence”. The Auditor/Customer Discussion Thread allows real-time per-control communication.
🏷 7 filter tabs for instant audit status filtering
📎 Choose Files → Add Submission Note → Submit Evidence
💬 Threaded discussion per control requirement
❓ “Request Requirement Modification” for clarifications
💼 Compliance Consultant Role

Step 10: Consultant Pre-Audit Review

Log out → log in as Consultant. Get credentials: Admin → Auditors → Consultants tab → 👁 Eye icon

🔒 http://localhost:5173/consultant/dashboard
10
Compliance Advisory Engagements
The Consultant portal shows all Active Client Advisory Projects assigned to them. Consultants perform pre-audit gap analysis — reviewing the customer’s evidence submissions before the formal QSA assessment begins, providing readiness recommendations and guidance.

Once assigned to a project, the consultant accesses the compliance audit matrix, reviews each control’s evidence, and posts discussion thread recommendations.

Note: Consultants will see “No client engagements currently assigned” until the Admin assigns them to a compliance project via Compliance Projects.
📋 Shows assigned client advisory projects
💬 Can comment on each control’s evidence
⚠ Must be assigned to a project by Admin first
🔍 QSA Assessor Role

Step 11: QSA Security Assessment

Log out → log in as QSA. Get credentials: Admin → Auditors → QSA Assessors tab → 👁 Eye icon

🔒 http://localhost:5173/qsa/dashboard
11
QSA Assessment Portal — Assigned Audits
The Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) sees all Assigned QSA Review Engagements. When assigned by admin, projects appear here for full audit access.

The QSA reviews each control’s evidence and can:
• Approve the customer’s evidence as PCI DSS compliant
• Disapprove and request corrective/additional evidence
• Upload QSA Working Papers (sampling logs, test results, interview notes)
• Post comments in the threaded discussion

After completing all controls, the engagement routes to QA for independent review.
📋 Shows all assigned audit projects
✅ Approve / ❌ Disapprove each control
📎 Upload QSA Working Papers per control
⚠ Must be assigned by Admin to appear here
✅ QA Auditor Role

Step 12: Quality Assurance Independent Review

Log out → log in as QA Auditor. Get credentials: Admin → Auditors → QA Auditors tab → 👁 Eye icon

🔒 http://localhost:5173/qa/dashboard
12
Quality Assurance (QA) Engagements
The QA Auditor provides an independent second-layer quality review — a critical compliance step where the QA validates the QSA’s assessment meets required standards.

The QA reviews both customer’s evidence AND QSA’s working papers for each control:
• QA Approve — gives the final certification for a control
• Request Modification — asks QSA to revise their assessment
• Batch approve — approve multiple controls efficiently at once
• Post comments in the threaded discussion
📋 Shows all assigned QA review engagements
✅ QA Approve = final certification of a control
📦 Batch approval for efficient bulk sign-off
⚠ Must be assigned by Admin to appear here
👑 Super Administrator — Final Step

Step 13: ROC/AOC Upload & Evidence Export

Log back in as Admin → Compliance Projects → Audit View of the completed project

🔒 http://localhost:5173/admin/compliances/[project-id]
13
ROC & AOC Upload — Final Certification
Once all compliance controls are QA Approved, the admin uploads the final official compliance certificates in the right panel (AOC & ROC tab):

• Attestation of Compliance (AOC) — The official attestation certifying the customer’s compliance. Upload the signed PDF.
• Report on Compliance (ROC) — The full detailed audit findings report. Upload the PDF.

Once uploaded, the Customer POC can download both documents from their “Attestations & Reports” section.

The “Export Evidence Package” button generates a complete ZIP archive with all customer evidence, QSA working papers, and a SHA-256 integrity manifest — the complete auditable record.
📜 Upload AOC PDF → Attestation of Compliance
📄 Upload ROC PDF → Report on Compliance
📦 “Export Evidence Package” → full ZIP + SHA-256 manifest
📅 Milestone tab → mark project completion date
